Copied upstream workflows are intentionally disabled in this BharatCode Desktop repository.

Do not re-enable copied upstream automation without auditing it for BharatCode ownership,
secrets, schedules, notification behavior, and release targets.

The `bharatcode-desktop-windows.yml` and `bharatcode-desktop-macos.yml` workflows are BharatCode-owned release automation. Keep their release targets, token usage, and public installer wording aligned with the Desktop release runbook before publishing assets.
